sentences.en: He not only graduated from studying sociology, but also philosophy.
sentences.zh: 他不仅学过社会学和哲学。

sentences.en: Truly, never before has bourgeois sociology known such a fall!
sentences.zh: 确实，资产阶级社会学从未经历过如此大的衰落！

sentences.en: Auguste Comte is regarded as the father of sociology.
sentences.zh: Auguste Comte 被认为是社会学之父。
